text_block_list.text:
After our outing, I accompanied Agnes 
Digital to a shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I won a ticket to the photobook release 
event I applied for the other day. So I'm 
getting ready for that.
choice_data_list: What are you going to buy?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's deodorant.
choice_data_list: Do we need it for the event?
Is it needed for the event?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, but I get all sweaty! I get so 
hyped and obsessed that I end up drenched 
in sweat every time, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What if the people around me notice the 
smell...! What if the smell reaches the 
Umamusume girls, heaven forbid...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"And if regular folks start gossiping that 
'Umamusume fans smell like sweat'... Oh 
no, that would be terrible...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Digitan can't go on living like this!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, lately I've had lots of chances 
to run alongside other Umamusume in races, 
haven't I?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm so particular about 
deodorant. I'm using unscented right now, 
but I wish there was something that 
neutralized odors completely...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...So that I can catch the scent of 
Umamusume, I want to eliminate the scent 
of my own shampoo and fabric softener. I 
want to become completely odorless—

"...Completely odorless, huh? Hmm, sounds 
pretty interesting, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyowa?! T-Tachyon-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I overheard an intriguing 
conversation while walking. A deodorant 
that makes you completely odorless... 
Shall I try making one?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In the course of past research, I once 
produced a liquid with high deodorizing 
efficacy. If I refine that, I should be 
able to make something similar.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Aww... Tachyon-san's eyes... They're 
sparkling with so much fun... So dreamy...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And so, Digital-kun, I would like to 
investigate your perspiration levels... 
Would you mind?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: With pleeeeeasure!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku... A fine answer. Well then, pardon 
me right away—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ……*sniff sniff*…… Hmm, I see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyogyawaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next is sweat volume. I'd like 
to observe your physiological reactions 
and sweat rate during actual deodorant 
usage, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, Digital-kun doesn't seem capable 
of answering. What kind of conditions do 
you think would be optimal for our 
experiment?"
choice_data_list: I think it's around the time of the race.

...Is that where Digital wants to go right 
now?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Before and after a race... so it's a 
situation where tension and excitement 
occur simultaneously?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, there is a place where you 
can reach a similar state. That would be 
much quicker than running."

The place Agnes Tachyon led me to —was a 
rollercoaster at an amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm right next to Tachyon-san?! M-My heart 
feels like it's gonna burst...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-To be this close to Tachyon-san... 
*pant* *pant*... M-My heart's racing... 
*pant* *gasp* *pant*!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Your breathing is quite ragged... Let's 
see, how much are you sweating?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-Too close! Tachyon-san's hair is 
touching my cheek...! No, no, Umamusume 
contact is strictly forbidden! B-But I 
can't get awaaaayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, did you hear that!? Right as the 
roller coaster dropped, Tachyon-san made a 
tiny little 'wha' sound!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A fleeting lapse where her intellectual 
demeanor cracked! An Ultra Super Special 
Rare moment! Peak emotional impact!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Splendid, Digital-kun! Your energy 
has stayed sky-high since before you even 
got on, and not once has it dropped!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are your endorphins limitless?! You're so 
far beyond the norm, it's hilarious! 
Hahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fuehh...! Tachyon-san is... L-Laughing out 
loud and having fun...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I must head back and analyze that 
reaction from just now! Excuse me, I'll be 
going ahead!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Digitan has... no regrets...!!

Supporting the unconscious Agnes Digital, 
I reconciled myself to the situation, 
thinking... well, at least both of them 
looked happy.

Later on, Agnes Digital happily came to 
report with the deodorant cream in hand. 
Apparently, the Agnes Tachyon-crafted 
concoction worked wonders.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're trying to recreate the excited 
state Digital-kun occasionally displays, 
yes? Well then, let us wake her up and 
ask.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Quite an unexpected choice coming 
from Digital-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I chose it because the cake comes highly 
recommended, but... are you not fond of 
this kind of shop...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, not particularly. If I had to say, it 
all depends on the taste.

Just then, the cake and black tea we 
ordered arrived. Agnes Tachyon immediately 
brought a bite of cake to her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Mnh... What is this...! The sweetness 
is invading my very brain...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, nice, this insane level of sweetness. 
Just the way I like it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
While such an eccentric color on a cake 
ruins the appetite, it appropriately 
suppresses dopamine release. Could it be 
designed to prevent excessive sugar 
intake?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aahn... Tachyon-san getting all excited 
over cake is just so precious... So 
precious...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Oh dear, I mustn't get distracted. How is 
Digital-kun doing...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Her face is flushed, and her breathing is 
ragged... She appears to be quite 
agitated. In such a tranquil setting... 
Heh heh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it seems Digital-kun requires a 
customized deodorant formulation. Let's 
see, first, a bactericidal agent—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaah! ●REC, ●REC! Preserve 
Tachyon-san's contemplative expression for 
all eternity!!

"Watching Agnes Tachyon having fun, Agnes 
Digital also looked exceedingly happy—"

Later on, Agnes Digital happily came to 
report with the deodorant cream in hand. 
Apparently, the Agnes Tachyon-crafted 
concoction worked wonders.
